# Tech Stack for Virgin Fund

## Frontend
- Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui for responsive, accessible UI.

## Backend
- Supabase (PostgreSQL) for DB/auth, Edge Functions for serverless logic.

## Integrations
- Alpaca Markets API (paper/live trading), CCXT for crypto, Stripe for billing.

## State Management
- React hooks, Context API, Zustand for complex state.

## Deployment
- Vercel/Netlify for frontend, Supabase for backend; Docker for local dev.
